page.overview:
Who is Corncob guy?

While riding on the Ba Sing Se Monorail in 100 AG, the corncob guy briefly crossed paths with Team Avatar. Ironically, this odd man showed up just as Sokka was expressing some rather irrational fears of his to the rest of Team Avatar, saying, "Weird stuff happens to us." His unexpected presence prompted a bewildered reaction from the group as he unceremoniously wedged himself in the seat between Sokka and Toph, all the while sucking on a corncob.
